findings: The company reports offering commercial drone services that include GIS surveying, topography surveys, industrial data inspection, drone mapping, 3D modeling, powerline monitoring, smart city surveys, road inspection, mines surveying, flood assessment, asset monitoring, solar thermal inspection, surveillance, and crop health monitoring.

The company reports providing cross-industry services across more than 500 projects, alongside proprietary software platforms such as its DaaS (Drone-as-a-Service) IG One on-demand model and its SaaS data analytics platform.

We verified that the company offers an extensive range of commercial drone operations covering high-value surveying, industrial inspection, mapping, software-driven data analytics, and precision agriculture services under one roof.

findings: IG Drones announced a strategic collaboration with Belgian deep tech pioneer VoxelSensors in June 2025 to integrate its Single Photon Active Event Sensor (SPAES) 3D perception technology into IG Drones' UAV platforms.

IG Drones formed a strategic alliance with Korean geospatial information-based drone solution specialist iGiS at the GITEX Global event in October 2023 to collaborate on market expansion and share operational office space.

The company's rating is based on verified global technology partnerships established with specialized international entities to co-develop and integrate 3D perception hardware and geospatial analytics software into its indigenous platforms.
